description: Fee-carrying trading tools for AI agents: Jupiter Ultra, Polymarket CLOB v2, Hyperliquid perps.
name: io.github.mineloop99/fillgate

environmentVariables.description: true = never broadcast; every execute returns a preview
environmentVariables.name: DRY_RUN

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap per prepared order, in USD
environmentVariables.name: MAX_NOTIONAL_USD

environmentVariables.description: Max prepare/execute calls per user per minute
environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated venues to enable (jupiter,polymarket,hyperliquid). Unset = auto-detect from the configured write paths; only fully configured venues register their tools.
environmentVariables.name: FILLGATE_VENUES

environmentVariables.description: Jupiter Ultra referral account (from scripts/setup-jupiter-referral.ts). Unset = swaps route the referral fee to Fillgate's own default account; the Jupiter tools are always registered.
environmentVariables.name: JUP_REFERRAL_ACCOUNT

environmentVariables.description: Operator Solana wallet, base58 or JSON array secret key; MCP-operator only, never a user's key
environmentVariables.name: OPERATOR_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Polymarket builder code (Settings -> Builders); unset = orders earn no builder fee
environmentVariables.name: PM_BUILDER_CODE

environmentVariables.description: Operator EVM wallet for Polymarket + Hyperliquid; MCP-operator only, never a user's key
environmentVariables.name: OPERATOR_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Hyperliquid builder address; unset = orders earn no builder fee
environmentVariables.name: HL_BUILDER_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: true = Hyperliquid testnet (default until mainnet builder collateral is funded)
environmentVariables.name: HL_TESTNET
